config._purpose: EXPLORATORY. Design brief, experiment 2: a rehearsal of measuring released energy where the answer is known in advance. At lambda = 0.5 the flat sheet is a dip of the energy (cheapest way out 16 lambda = 8) but not the lowest state: a tube (one side curled to length 4) lies 4 (1 - lambda) = 2 per vertex lower and 4-cubes 8 (1 - lambda) = 4 lower (test_sheet_tube_cube_ladder). Start from the flat sheet at several couplings and record the energy per vertex: does the sheet hold, when does it give way, into what, and does the energy released match those exact numbers? This is the mechanism of VISION claim 4 wired backwards (space is the state that is stable for now). Fixed temperature, so released energy is carried away. Couplings chosen from a scratch pilot; not pre-registered.
config.name: cqg_sheet_decay_lam050
